# Level 1 · Numbers That Learn

Three ideas carry the whole field: multiply-and-add (a layer is a matrix times a vector), slope (which way is downhill), and the walk (take a small step, repeat). You write all three with plain Python lists. No NumPy, on purpose: when you know what the loops do, a library becomes a speed-up instead of a mystery.
